models.name: Coffee Shop POPS Domain Model
models.description: Operational POPS model for a coffee shop covering menu setup, order intake, payment, production/fulfillment, inventory, daily operationss, and customer service.

objects.name: Coffee Shop Operations
objects.description: End-to-end store operations for selling and fulfilling coffee shop orders.

objects.name: Menu & Pricing Setup
objects.description: Define menu items, modifiers, availability windows, pricing rules, and taxes.

objects.name: Define Items, Modifiers, Sizes, Availability
objects.description: Configure items, modifiers, sizes, and availability windows.

objects.name: Configure Pricing Rules & Taxes
objects.description: Set pricing rules, store-specific pricing, and tax configuration.

objects.name: Order Intake
objects.description: Capture customer order details, validate availability, and confirm order with readiness estimate.

objects.name: Capture Customer Order Details
objects.description: Capture items, modifiers, and special instructions.

objects.name: Validate Item/Ingredient Availability
objects.description: Validate availability including out-of-stock ingredients and disabled items.

objects.name: Confirm Order & Provide Readiness Time
objects.description: Provide order confirmation and estimated readiness time where applicable.

objects.name: Payment & Tender
objects.description: Accept payment, apply discounts/promotions, issue receipts, and handle refunds/voids/comps.

objects.name: Accept Payment
objects.description: Take payment for the order using supported tenders.

objects.name: Apply Discounts/Promotions
objects.description: Apply discounts and promotions to the order total.

objects.name: Issue Receipt
objects.description: Provide receipt to customer after payment.

objects.name: Handle Refunds, Voids & Comps
objects.description: Process refunds, voids, and comps with appropriate controls.

objects.name: Production & Fulfillment
objects.description: Route orders to stations, prepare items, stage completed items, hand off to customer, and manage remakes.

objects.name: Route Order to Stations
objects.description: Route order to appropriate station(s) such as espresso bar, drip, or kitchen.

objects.name: Prepare Items
objects.description: Prepare items according to recipe standards and customization rules.

objects.name: Stage Completed Items
objects.description: Stage completed items for pickup.

objects.name: Hand Off Order to Customer
objects.description: Hand off completed order using name/number-based pickup.

objects.name: Manage Remake Flow
objects.description: Manage remake flow for incorrect or unsatisfactory items.

objects.name: Inventory Usage & Replenishment (Store-Level)
objects.description: Receive deliveries, track consumption, record waste/spoilage, adjust on-hand counts, and trigger replenishment signals.

objects.name: Receive Deliveries & Verify Quantities
objects.description: Receive deliveries, verify quantities, and store items appropriately.

objects.name: Track Ingredient Consumption
objects.description: Track ingredient consumption driven by sales and prep.

objects.name: Record Waste/Spoilage
objects.description: Record waste/spoilage and adjust on-hand counts.

objects.name: Trigger Replenishment Signals
objects.description: Trigger replenishment signals using thresholds/par levels as inputs to ordering (if applicable).

objects.name: Daily Store Operations
objects.description: Opening, mid-shift, and closing routines including prep, cleaning, calibration, and cash reconciliation.

objects.name: Opening Procedures
objects.description: Equipment warm-up, prep, cash drawer setup, and station readiness.

objects.name: Mid-Shift Operations
objects.description: Restocking, cleaning cycles, and calibration checks.

objects.name: Closing Procedures
objects.description: Cash reconciliation, cleaning, waste logs, and next-day prep.

objects.name: Customer Service
objects.description: Resolve issues, process refunds/remakes, and capture reason codes for improvement.

objects.name: Resolve Customer Issues
objects.description: Resolve missing items, delays, and quality concerns.

objects.name: Process Refund/Remake
objects.description: Process refunds/remakes as part of issue resolution.

objects.name: Capture Reason Codes
objects.description: Capture reason codes for improvement and reporting.

objects.name: Store Manager
objects.description: Responsible for store operations, controls, and oversight.

objects.name: Front Counter Staff
objects.description: Staff handling order intake, customer interaction, and pickup coordination.

objects.name: Barista Team
objects.description: Staff preparing espresso/drip beverages and coordinating fulfillment.

objects.name: Kitchen Staff
objects.description: Staff preparing food items where applicable.

objects.name: Inventory/Stock Clerk
objects.description: Staff receiving deliveries, stocking, and maintaining inventory records.

objects.name: POS System
objects.description: Point-of-sale system for menu, order capture, pricing, and receipts.

objects.name: Payment Processing System
objects.description: System/service used to authorize and capture payments and refunds.

objects.name: Kitchen/Production Display System
objects.description: System used to route and display orders to production stations.

objects.name: Inventory Management System
objects.description: System used to track on-hand inventory, waste, and replenishment signals.

objects.name: Configured Menu
objects.description: Menu configuration including items, modifiers, sizes, availability, pricing, and taxes.

objects.name: Confirmed Customer Order
objects.description: Validated and confirmed order ready for payment and production.

objects.name: Receipt
objects.description: Customer receipt issued after payment.

objects.name: Prepared Items
objects.description: Prepared beverages/food items ready for staging and handoff.

objects.name: Updated Inventory Records
objects.description: Updated on-hand counts, waste logs, and replenishment indicators.

objects.name: Ordering Service
objects.description: Service of taking and confirming customer orders with readiness estimates.

objects.name: Payment Service
objects.description: Service of accepting payment and issuing receipts, including refunds/voids/comps.
